_description: Feature flag definitions for the Meridian Health platform.

enable_new_scheduling_ui.description: New scheduling interface with drag-and-drop calendar and improved slot finder

claims_auto_adjudication.description: Automatically adjudicate simple claims (single CPT, known payer, clean scrub) without manual review

fhir_bulk_export.description: Enable FHIR Bulk Data Export ($export) endpoint for payer data exchange

patient_chat_beta.description: Real-time chat between patients and care team members (replaces async messaging)

enhanced_eligibility_check.description: Use the new Availity real-time API for eligibility instead of batch 270/271

telehealth_zoom_integration.description: Use Zoom for telehealth visits instead of Twilio Video
telehealth_zoom_integration._note: Twilio Video deprecated. This flag should be removed once migration is confirmed complete.

dark_mode.description: Enable dark mode toggle in patient and provider portals
dark_mode._note: Paused due to accessibility concerns with contrast ratios in dark mode. Needs design review.

claims_anomaly_detection.description: ML-based anomaly detection for suspicious claim patterns (upcoding, unbundling)

patient_self_scheduling.description: Allow patients to self-schedule appointments without calling the office
patient_self_scheduling._note: STALE FLAG - This has been at 100% for over a year. Should be removed and code cleaned up.

enable_consent_service.description: Route consent management through the new consent-service instead of inline logic

provider_mobile_app.description: Enable access from the provider mobile app (React Native)

automated_prior_auth.description: Automatically submit prior authorization requests for procedures that require them
automated_prior_auth._note: Blocked on CMS interoperability rule finalization for electronic prior auth

v2_patient_search.description: Use the new Elasticsearch-backed patient search with phonetic matching
v2_patient_search._note: STALE FLAG - Has been at 100% since July 2024. Old search code can be removed.
